summary: Describes how GMPLS Label Switched Paths can be aggregated into a hierarchy to improve scalability. A router can create a TE path and advertise it as a forwarding adjacency, a link that other paths can use. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Many small roads can merge into one highway, and cars drive the highway as if it were just another road. This memo explains that layered trick for network paths.
